body:
**Filing gate ③** — maintainer-directed. The maintainer, in session `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4` (2026-10-16), asked verbatim 「ci红的报bug了没」; this workflow's red had no card. Same exchange, verbatim: 「我不是马上要发布，就是测试看还有什么新问题，一起都要解决」.

**Filed by** the PM seat in that session · `os-sales`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's: the landing point cannot be named before pass 1's failing tests are read — it may be test pollution spread across packages, or this job's own shape.

**Reader who acts:** the triage seat routes it; the dev's first read is the failing test names inside pass 1 of run 38679312462.

## Readings

`.github/workflows/rerun-safety-nightly.yml`, verdict lines from `scripts/rerun-safety-verdict.mjs` in each run's log:

| night | run | head | pass 1 failing | pass 2 failing | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 10-14 | 38509291145 | `6eb6f7d65b` | `@objectstack/cli#test`, `@objectstack/dogfood#test` | `@objectstack/core#test`, `@objectstack/lint#test`, `@objectstack/spec#test` | `RERUN_UNSAFE_ON_BROKEN_BASELINE` |
| 10-15 | 38679312462 | `16abea8845` | `@objectstack/cli#test`, `@objectstack/dogfood#test` | `@objectstack/cli#test`, `@objectstack/organizations#test`, `@objectstack/runtime#test`, `@objectstack/verify#test` | `RERUN_UNSAFE_ON_BROKEN_BASELINE` |
| 10-16 | 38848504327 | `9b799e6fb5` | — | — | cancelled at ~2h55m (job `timeout-minutes: 170`) |

- Pass 1 fails the same two packages two nights running, while the hourly full battery on main (`CI`: Test Core 6 shards, Dogfood 3 shards) stayed green through the same window. Either those suites fail only in this job's shape (one runner, unsharded `pnpm test`), or the sharded runs miss something. Not measured.
- The pass-2-only set differs every night (core / lint / spec, then organizations / runtime / verify): the rerun-unsafe finding this job exists to report, or load-dependent flake. Not measured.
- The workflow has no step that files an issue on red, so three red nights reached no one until a maintainer asked.

## Done when

- Pass 1's `cli` and `dogfood` failures in this job are root-caused: fixed, or shown to be this job's environment and the job corrected.
- Each package that fails only on pass 2 either passes a second run in one tree, or has its own card naming the polluting test and the file it writes.
- A nightly run concludes `success`, or names only failures that already have cards.
